panels.title: Messages processed
panels.description: Emails processed (latest run per email; duplicates excluded).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let runs = traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where message startswith "remittance_run_completed "
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 25))
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, e) by processingId = tostring(e.processingId), runId = tostring(e.runId)
| extend payer = tostring(e.payerName), messageClass = tostring(e.messageClass), outcome = tostring(e.outcome),
         lines = toint(e.lineCount), paymentTotal = todouble(e.paymentTotal), cost = todouble(e.estimatedCost),
         durationMs = toint(e.durationMs), remittanceDate = tostring(e.remittanceDate),
         day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, '$tz'))
| where ${payer:singlequote} == '__all' or payer == ${payer:singlequote}
| where ${class:singlequote} == '__all' or messageClass == ${class:singlequote};
let messages = runs | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by processingId | where outcome != "duplicate";
messages | count

options.content:
**Straight-through:** the AI processed the remittance end to end - read the email and its attachments, extracted every payment line, verified each line against its source, reconciled to the payment and produced the payment file, ready for cash application. *First pass*: verified on the first extraction. *AI-resolved*: the ACH Resolution Expert reasoned across the sources to recover the lines or details, and its answer was verified before it was applied.

**Time saved (estimate):** straight-through messages x the *Manual minutes per message* setting above, the business's estimate of the manual effort per remittance.

**Costs (estimate):** from each run's recorded AI usage and the configured rates (today Azure list prices, before negotiated discounts, credits or taxes). Azure Cost Management is the billing record.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let runs = traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where message startswith "remittance_run_completed "
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 25))
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, e) by processingId = tostring(e.processingId), runId = tostring(e.runId)
| extend payer = tostring(e.payerName), messageClass = tostring(e.messageClass), outcome = tostring(e.outcome),
         lines = toint(e.lineCount), paymentTotal = todouble(e.paymentTotal), cost = todouble(e.estimatedCost),
         durationMs = toint(e.durationMs), remittanceDate = tostring(e.remittanceDate),
         day = startofday(datetime_utc_to_local(timestamp, '$tz'))
| where ${payer:singlequote} == '__all' or payer == ${payer:singlequote}
| where ${class:singlequote} == '__all' or messageClass == ${class:singlequote};
let messages = runs | summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by processingId | where outcome != "duplicate";
let totals = runs | summarize totalCost = sum(cost) by processingId;
messages
| join kind=leftouter totals on processingId
| summarize Messages = count(), ['Straight-through %'] = round(100.0 * countif(outcome in ("handled_by_rules", "handled_by_agents")) / count(), 1),
            ['Needs review'] = countif(outcome == "flagged_for_review"), Lines = sum(lines), Dollars = round(sum(paymentTotal), 2),
            ['AI cost'] = round(sum(totalCost), 4) by Payer = iff(isempty(payer), "(unknown)", payer)
| extend ['Cost per message'] = round(['AI cost'] / Messages, 4)
| order by Messages desc

| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where message startswith "remittance_run_completed "
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 25))
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, e) by processingId = tostring(e.processingId), runId = tostring(e.runId)
| extend payer = tostring(e.payerName), messageClass = tostring(e.messageClass), outcome = tostring(e.outcome),

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let runs = traces
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where message startswith "remittance_run_completed "
| extend e = parse_json(substring(message, 25))
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, e) by processingId = tostring(e.processingId), runId = tostring(e.runId)
| extend payer = tostring(e.payerName), messageClass = tostring(e.messageClass), outcome = tostring(e.outcome),
         lines = toint(e.lineCount), paymentTotal = todouble(e.paymentTotal), cost = todouble(e.estimatedCost),
